Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Public preview updates for November 2021

Body.Content:
In November 2021, the following preview updates and enhancements were made to Microsoft Defender for Cloud (formerly Azure Security Center):

  • Prioritize security actions by data sensitivity (powered by Azure Purview) (in preview)
  • Snapshot export for recommendations and security findings (in preview)
